text.autoconfig.longhotbar.title: Long Hotbar Config
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.modDis: When ON, the mod is completely disabled: no double hotbar, no item swapping, and the toggle key (=) will not work. You must turn this off via config file or Mod Menu to re-enable.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.disabl: When ON, the hotbar reverts to the vanilla single-bar appearance (no double bars), but item swapping still works.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.hotbar: DUAL = two bars (original); TRIPLE = three side‑by‑side; QUAD = four side‑by‑side.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.sideGa: Gap between the left and right hotbars in pixels. Only effective when Vanilla Style Mode is OFF.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.offhan: Horizontal offset of the offhand slot icon from the left edge of the left hotbar. Only effective when Vanilla Style Mode is OFF.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.longPr: How many milliseconds you must hold R or = to trigger a long press action. Range: 180–1000 ms.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.playSw: When ON, plays a pickup sound when swapping items or toggling hotbar position via key presses (R, =, double-tap numbers). Does not play for scroll wheel auto-swap.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.enable: When ON, pressing Ctrl+1/2/3/4 switches hotbar mode without changing the selected slot.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.shortc: The modifier key to hold while pressing 1-4 for quick mode switching. (Ctrl+2→DUAL, Ctrl+3→TRIPLE, Ctrl+4→QUAD, Ctrl+1 toggles Vanilla Style). Options: Left Ctrl, Right Ctrl, Left Alt, Right Alt, Left Shift, Right Shift.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.invert: When OFF: Tap R = full row swap + toggle position, Hold R = full row swap only. When ON: Tap R = full row swap only, Hold R = full row swap + toggle position.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.single: When ON: Tap R swaps only the main hand item. When OFF: Tap R swaps the entire row (position toggling depends on 'Invert Swap Behavior'). Long press behavior is separate.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.swapRo: Which inventory row to swap with the main hotbar: 1 = top row (slots 9-17), 2 = middle row (18-26), 3 = bottom row (27-35).
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.revers: When ON, long pressing = cycles swap row from bottom to top (3→2→1→3) instead of top to bottom (1→2→3→1).
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.longPr: When ON: tapping R swaps the 8 items in the hotbar other than the currently selected slot (the main hand item stays). When OFF: tapping R follows the behavior defined by 'Single Item Swap Mode' and 'Invert Swap Behavior'. Long pressing R always swaps the entire row and toggles left/right hotbar position.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.swapEq: When ON, short pressing = cycles the swap row, and long pressing toggles vanilla style mode. When OFF, the default behavior is preserved (short press toggles vanilla style, long press cycles swap row). Default: ON.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.scroll: When holding the scroll multiplier modifier key, each scroll step moves the hotbar selection by this many slots. Range 2-9.
text.autoconfig.longhotbar.option.pickBl: When ON, middle-clicking a block will search the inventory and swap the entire matching row into the hotbar. When OFF, middle-click behaves as vanilla (only searches the hotbar).
longhotbar.configuration.modDisabled.too: When ON, the mod is completely disabled: no double hotbar, no item swapping, and the toggle key (=) does nothing. (Applies to all modes)
longhotbar.configuration.disableMod.tool: Single bar appearance, swapping still works. (Applies to all modes)
longhotbar.configuration.hotbarMode.tool: DUAL = two bars (original); TRIPLE = three side‑by‑side; QUAD = four side‑by‑side.
longhotbar.configuration.sideGap.tooltip: Gap between hotbars in pixels. (Applies to all modes)
longhotbar.configuration.offhandOffset.t: Horizontal offset of offhand slot from left edge of leftmost hotbar. (Applies to all modes)
longhotbar.configuration.invertSwapBehav: (DUAL mode only) When OFF: Tap R = full row swap + toggle position, Hold R = full row swap only. When ON: Tap R = full row swap only, Hold R = full row swap + toggle position.
longhotbar.configuration.singleItemSwapM: (DUAL mode only) When ON: Tap R swaps only the main hand item. When OFF: Tap R swaps the entire row (position toggling depends on Invert Swap Behavior).
longhotbar.configuration.swapRow.tooltip: (DUAL mode only) Which inventory row to swap with the main hotbar: 1 = top row (slots 9-17), 2 = middle row (18-26), 3 = bottom row (27-35).
longhotbar.configuration.reverseSwapRowC: (DUAL mode only) When ON, long pressing = cycles swap row from bottom to top (3→2→1→3) instead of top to bottom (1→2→3→1).
longhotbar.configuration.longPressOnlySw: (DUAL mode only) When ON: tapping R swaps the 8 items in the hotbar other than the currently selected slot (the main hand item stays). When OFF: tapping R follows the behavior defined by Single Item Swap Mode and Invert Swap Behavior.
longhotbar.configuration.swapEqualShortL: (DUAL mode only) When ON, short pressing = cycles the swap row, and long pressing toggles vanilla style mode. When OFF, short pressing toggles vanilla style mode, and long pressing cycles the swap row.
longhotbar.configuration.longPressDelayM: How many milliseconds you must hold R or = to trigger a long press action. Range: 180–1000 ms. (Applies to all modes)
longhotbar.configuration.playSwapSound.t: When ON, plays a pickup sound when swapping items or toggling hotbar position via key presses (R, =, double-tap numbers). Does not play for scroll wheel auto-swap. (Applies to all modes)
longhotbar.configuration.enableCtrlNumbe: When ON, pressing modifier key + 1/2/3/4 switches hotbar mode without changing the selected slot. (Applies to all modes)
longhotbar.configuration.shortcutModifie: The modifier key to hold while pressing 1-4 for quick mode switching. (Ctrl+2→DUAL, Ctrl+3→TRIPLE, Ctrl+4→QUAD, Ctrl+1 toggles Vanilla Style). Options: Left Ctrl, Right Ctrl, Left Alt, Right Alt, Left Shift, Right Shift. (Applies to all modes)
longhotbar.configuration.pickBlockSingle: When ON, middle-clicking a block will search the inventory and swap the entire matching row into the hotbar. When OFF, middle-click behaves as vanilla (only searches the hotbar).
longhotbar.configuration.scrollMultiplie: When holding the scroll multiplier modifier key, each scroll step moves the hotbar selection by this many slots. Range 2-9.
